lanes.label: Official record
lanes.semantic_definition: Statements, notices and documents issued by a registered public authority; authority is source identity, not automatic truth.

lanes.label: News observation
lanes.semantic_definition: Registered news retrieval or corpus evidence describing attention or reporting; volume and language are not event magnitude.

lanes.label: Coded event context
lanes.semantic_definition: Provider-coded or research-coded event observations; coding is retained as a distinct measurement process, not ground truth.

lanes.label: Physical transmission
lanes.semantic_definition: Observed physical throughput, congestion, movement or infrastructure state; it is not inferred from headlines or prices.

lanes.label: Trade transmission
lanes.semantic_definition: Observed trade-flow, customs or shipment quantities under a declared trade denominator and vintage.

lanes.label: Energy transmission
lanes.semantic_definition: Observed energy supply, demand, inventory or flow context under its own unit, frequency and revision policy.

lanes.label: Market transmission
lanes.semantic_definition: Observed market prices or returns; market association is neither physical disruption nor causal attribution.

lanes.label: Public attention
lanes.semantic_definition: Observed public-platform attention under a registered query and population; it is not opinion, probability or event severity.
